oncall_health.indicator.loading: Health status is loading. Click to open diagnostics.
oncall_health.indicator.unknown: Health status is unknown. Click to open diagnostics.
oncall_health.errors.summary_missing_rot: Health summary was not returned for this rotation.
oncall_health.errors.summary_missing_tea: Team health summary was not returned.
oncall_health.errors.team_summary_failed: Team health summary failed to load.
oncall_health.errors.rotation_id_missing: Rotation id was not found for this health indicator.
oncall_health.errors.team_id_missing: Team id was not found for this health indicator.
oncall_health.errors.team_details_failed: Failed to load team health details.
oncall_health.empty.rotation: No on-call health issues were found for this rotation.
oncall_health.empty.team: No team health issues were found.
oncall_health.issues.rotation_disabled.m: This rotation does not participate in on-call scheduling while disabled.
oncall_health.issues.rotation_disabled.h: Enable the rotation when it should handle alerts.
oncall_health.issues.rotation_disabled_b: Disabled rotation is used by an enabled route
At least one enabled alert route still points to this disabled rotation.
Enable the rotation, change the route rotation, or disable the route.
oncall_health.issues.rotation_has_no_lay: Add at least one enabled layer with users, cadence and coverage windows.
Open rotation layers and create the first layer.
oncall_health.issues.rotation_has_no_ena: All layers are disabled, so the rotation cannot produce an on-call user.
Enable a layer or create a new enabled layer.
oncall_health.issues.enabled_layer_has_n: Enabled layer has no active members
An enabled layer has no active users in the checked window.
Add active team users to this layer or disable it.
oncall_health.issues.rotation_has_no_act: Enabled rotation has no active users in enabled layers.
Add active users to an enabled layer.
oncall_health.issues.rotation_has_single: Rotation has only one active member
Only one active user can be selected across enabled layers.
Add at least one more user to reduce single-person on-call risk.
oncall_health.issues.layer_has_inactive_: Inactive users are still present in enabled layers.
Remove inactive users from the layer or reactivate them.
oncall_health.issues.no_current_oncall.m: The rotation cannot resolve an assignee right now.
oncall_health.issues.no_current_oncall.h: Check enabled layers, restrictions, start date and members.
oncall_health.issues.current_oncall_user: The currently selected user is inactive or deleted.
Remove inactive users from active layers or reactivate the user.
Current on-call user has no direct notification contact
The current on-call user has no email, phone, Telegram, Slack or Mattermost identifier.
Ask the user to complete profile contacts or enable profile notification rules.
oncall_health.issues.member_has_no_deliv: Layer member has no direct notification contact
A layer member has no email, phone, Telegram, Slack or Mattermost identifier.
Ask the user to complete profile contacts or configure profile notification rules.
oncall_health.issues.schedule_gap.title: Schedule gap detected
oncall_health.issues.schedule_gap.messag: No active on-call user can be resolved for part of the checked window.
oncall_health.issues.schedule_gap.hint: Check layer restrictions, users and override windows.
oncall_health.issues.schedule_gap_output: Only the first schedule gaps are shown. Fix the listed gaps and run diagnostics again.
Reduce schedule gaps or run diagnostics for a shorter window.
oncall_health.issues.team_disabled.title: Team is disabled
oncall_health.issues.team_disabled.messa: Disabled teams cannot receive active alert routing.
oncall_health.issues.team_disabled.hint: Enable the team when it should receive alerts.
oncall_health.issues.team_has_no_active_: Alerts routed to this team cannot resolve a rotation assignee unless another explicit target is configured.
Create and enable at least one rotation for this team.
oncall_health.issues.team_has_no_enabled: Team has no enabled notification channels
Enabled routes can receive alerts, but no team notification channels are enabled.
Enable at least one channel or intentionally rely on profile-level notifications.
oncall_health.issues.route_has_no_assign: Enabled route has no assignment target
An enabled route has neither a rotation nor an escalation policy assigned.
Attach a rotation or an escalation policy that can resolve an assignee.
oncall_health.issues.route_has_no_channe: Enabled route has no channel links
An enabled route has no linked channels.
Link at least one channel to the route or intentionally rely on profile notifications.
oncall_health.issues.team_rotation_has_c: A team rotation has critical health issues.
Open rotation health diagnostics for details.
oncall_health.issues.team_rotation_has_w: A team rotation has health warnings.
Open rotation health diagnostics for details.
